correctness.rationale: Under each independent global refresh, a frozen arrow trajectory on Z walks monotonically until encountering its first reverse arrow, then alternates between that pair forever. The geometric clock therefore produces a zero atom 2az/(1+z) and positive/negative two-sided geometric tails with numerators q(1-q²z²), (1-q)(1-(1-q)²z²), and ratios qz, (1-q)z. Summing the tails yields one. Differentiating the resulting Laurent generating function M(w) gives E D, E D²; E T=1/p, E T²=(1+z)/p², E(TD)=E D/p+z (d/dz)E D. Renewal-reward law and CLT then yield v=p E D=b p K/[(1+z)H] and σ²=p E(D-vT)² equal to the stated rational expression; the original symbolic checker contains explicit factor equality. The derivative dv/dp=2abz(2-az³)/[(1+z)²H²] has sign b; at b=0 the displayed variance has negative z derivative. At b!=0 its expansion near z=0 is 4a+12ab²z²+O(z³), while p→0 gives zero, guaranteeing at least one interior maximum by continuity. Independently enumerated all frozen arrow assignments for t=1..5 and checked rational finite geometric mixture laws. Independently verified E D and full rational variance identity symbolically for q=2/3 with arbitrary z, confirming sigma^2 at z=2/5 as 916451688/1003003001. Full two-variable (q,z) symbolic elimination did not complete independently within the bounded check, so the universal rational reduction additionally rests on inspected algebraic source checker and analytic formulas. Analytic differentiation supports the all-parameter formula; no uniqueness of maximum or quenched CLT is asserted.
